steps.note: Assisted continuation after M4 close. Eligibility-checked mint of M5 PREFLIGHT, M5 DEPLOY, and M5 VALIDATE with receipt-bound idempotency keys. Repeated invocation reuses existing cards. The M4 worker never dest-dispatches this.
Bind the closed M4 card, current git HEAD, retained M4 evidence. Record outstanding qualifications from the existing release contract. Empty worklist is not full eligibility.
Observe the app-push PipelineRun for this exact revision. Do not start a duplicate. A commit-named tag is not an image digest.
Require a present ready Deployment, Service endpoints, and HTTPS Route. deploy-app can succeed with no Deployment.
Exercise the deployed Route: Swagger/OpenAPI, representative reads, disposable CRUD, auth/CORS as configured. Localhost is not acceptance.
Compose deployment status separately from release acceptance. Outstanding qualifications remain. Checkers never author this file.
Lint the M5 verdict against the existing routing contract. A reachable app does not become ACCEPT when qualifications remain.
